findings.description: The sync wrapper sets `copy._local.statistics = self._local.statistics` instead of the shared `stats` dict. The async version correctly uses `stats`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to a function decorated with sync @retry. `self._local.statistics` is the thread-local dict, which may be the original `self.statistics` or a stale or fresh dict from an earlier call. The copy therefore records attempt statistics into a dict other than `wrapped_f.statistics`. The `stats` dict that was just cleared stays empty, so users reading `f.statistics`, including through outer wrappers, see `{}` instead of attempt_number and similar fields. This defeats the fix for #519 and also breaks existing behavior.
